days.title: Northern Eichsfeld Cliffs and Castles
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Burg Hanstein
stops.detail: Hanstein Castle was mentioned in documents for the first time in the 9th century and towers over the village of Bornhagen.

stops.name: Teufelskanzel
stops.detail: The Teufelskanzel is a massive sandstone rock at a point on the Höheberg 452 m above sea level (maximum 510.7 m above sea level).

stops.name: Gobert
stops.detail: The Gobert, with the highest elevation of the Eichsfeld and also of the nature park, the Goburg (543.4 m above sea level), its signposted hiking trails and its species-rich flora, is one of the most beautiful hiking areas in the Eichsfeld.

stops.name: Naturparkzentrum in Fürstenhagen
stops.detail: The nature park center in Fürstenhagen is located in the former Fürstenhagen railway station.

days.title: Waterfalls and Highlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Lutterwasserfall
stops.detail: The Lutter waterfall is located near Großbartloff and is impressive to look at with a height of 10 m.

stops.name: Dieteröder Klippen
stops.detail: For example, the nature trail of the nature park passes the Dieteröder Klippen located near Dieterode, from which there is a panoramic view of the Obereichsfeld.

stops.name: Naturschutzgebiet Lengenberg
stops.detail: The Lengenberg nature reserve offers the largest stock of yew trees in Thuringia.

days.title: Werra Valley Vistas and Trails
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Heldrastein
stops.detail: The Heldrastein near Heldra is considered the king of the Werra valley; from the Tower of Unity, one enjoys an excellent distant view over the Thuringian nature park.

stops.name: Naturschutzgebiet Probsteizella
stops.detail: The Probsteizella nature reserve possesses in the Falken Cliffs a breathtakingly steep rock face that reaches right down to the banks of the Werra.

stops.name: Naturparkweg Leine-Werra
stops.detail: The Leine-Werra Nature Park Trail leads over 103 kilometers from Heilbad Heiligenstadt on the Leine to Creuzburg on the Werra.
